g.text: Terms: EXT-BYSTANDER = external element: bystanders · EXT-CREW = external element: ground crew and maintainers · EXT-GNSS-RF = external element: GNSS and RF environment ·
EXT-PILOT = external element: pilot · EXT-TERRAIN = external element: terrain and obstacles · GNSS = global navigation satellite system (GPS and similar) · GPS = Global
Positioning System · RF = radio frequency · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1 =
integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
